messages:
Alex: seeing a sudden spike in evictions in eu-central GPU pool, node_count down ~18% and GPU_util at 94% — queuing up tokens, tail latency rising.
Tara: noticed same in the dashboards. network flaps reported to power vendor earlier today? unclear if related. need immediate mitigation.
Alex: yep, vendor reported maintenance hits on 3 racks. impact on reserved capacity and autoscaler struggling to replenish.
OpsBot: autoscaler: 2026-06-18T12:03:24Z scale_down_failed: insufficient healthy_nodes. evictions: 42 in 10m.
Mike: recommend emergency regional rate limiting + shift traffic to eu-west (regional peering OK) and apac spare capacity where possible.
Tara: agree. propose a two-tier emergency policy: default clients get 60% of their steady-state QPS, premium customers get 85% by manual opt-in. short window ETA 2h.
Jing: will apply config to ingress policy. preparing curl to post new rateplan. ping me when ready to flip.
Jing: ```
# applying emergency rateplan to eu-central ingress
curl -X POST 'https://control.internal.redwood/v1/admin/rateplans' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"region":"eu-central","plan":"emergency-tiered-2026-06-18","default_pct":60,"premium_pct":85,"ttl":"2h"}'
```
Tara: also add per-customer burst tokens = 2000 tokens/day to avoid blocking small bursts.
Mike: must exclude critical customers (cc:SupportLead) from default cap until we get buy-in. list of top 10 sent to you, Tara.
SupportLead: copying top10 now. we'll pause billing-impacting changes for customers with active escalations; will send opt-out forms to Sales for opt-in.
OpsBot: rateplan emplace job started (job_id rpl-789). rolling to 12 proxies in eu-central.
OpsBot: job rpl-789: step 4/12 applied.
Alex: flipping 3 proxies now to divert baseline traffic to eu-west for lower-cost customers. monitor egress and latency.
Jing: egress rules updated. verifying KV caches — will warm prefix cache in eu-west to avoid cold start penalties.
Tara: support templates: "We're applying temporary rate limits in eu-central to maintain stability; your service may see lower throughput. ETA 2 hrs." Use internal status page link.
SupportLead: got it. sending to top10 and creating one-off exceptions for 2 enterprise customers.
Mike: monitoring metrics: GPU_util down to 78% after first 6 proxies. queue_depth dropping. :white_check_mark:
Alex: good. keep an eye for any increased error 503s from the ingress. if >1% we rollback limits and notify.
Tara: we should also enable automatic fallback to smaller model variants for non-enterprise customers to reduce token burn.
Jing: added model-fallback policy to the same rateplan (non-enterprise: lite-quantized fallback).
OpsBot: model-fallback and rate limits are active on all updated proxies.
SupportLead: customers notified. one reply from "AcmeCorp" asking for a timeline, told them ~90m and sent opt-in link.
Mike: ticketing: create incident ticket and mark severity S2. Assign postmortem to Alex/Tara/Jing.
Alex: assigning now. We'll reconvene at 12:45 UTC for status update and a rollback plan if recovery not underway.
Tara: thanks everyone. quick notes: rollback steps are the same curl but set default_pct=100 and remove model-fallback. keep logs for postmortem.
Jing: logs/evictions, scaling events, and rateplan job trace saved under /incidents/1791123456/artifacts.
Alex: great job. continuing to monitor. :thumbsup:
